::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 6th [1892-1898]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear [Miss Higginbotham](people/person_693.qmd)
I think you will find the beginning of the stories in the [Castle builders](cmy_books/cmybook_18.qmd) & [Countess Kate](cmy_books/cmybook_44.qmd), which are in the hands of [Innes](people/person_744.qmd), 31 Bedford Street Covent Garden.[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The question was evidently which were the earliest of the linked stories.  Innes reprinted *Countess Kate* in 1892 and *The Castle-Builders* in 1896.
